sites.downstream: result.object → console.log (genre label); result.usage → console.log (token counts); result.finishReason → console.log
sites.reason: Single selection from a closed set of 5 genre labels over trusted, short text. No math, dates, multi-hop reasoning, generation, adversarial input, or large irrelevant state. Textbook Choice primitive scenario.

options.benefit: Accepted decisions use Jev (~100ms, ~$0.042/M tokens vs gpt-4o-mini ~$0.15/M input + $0.60/M output). Latency improves on accepted decisions.
options.risk: Low confidence or Jev errors fall through to existing generateObject path. Conservative posture retains this fallback permanently. Usage/finishReason diagnostics are adapter-mapped on Jev path.

options.benefit: No conversion work or risk. Original behavior preserved exactly.
